text:
Elaine (Sales): ACME wants to temporarily reduce their Dedicated POC reserve and shorten the burst window to save on demo costs. Pool: ded-poc-acme-03. Current: min_capacity=20, burst_window=2h. Request: min_capacity=6, burst_window=30m for demo window only. Also need hosted API key rotation with a short TTL and IP allowlist. Can ops implement without breaching the reserved contract? Need signoff by EOD.

Mike (Eng): A few quick questions: is there an expected spike after the demo or will traffic fall off? Do they want hosted fallback configured if capacity exhausted? Any procurement constraints about minimum guaranteed capacity?

Irene (ACME): After the demo traffic drops to ~10% for ~3 days. We only need peak for the live demo tomorrow. No fallback required, but we want a fast rollback path if something unexpected happens. Any billing penalties for short reductions?

Charlie (Infra): We can do a temporary headroom reduction + shorten burst window but note: 1) Reserved commits usually need 24h notice to change min_capacity. 2) We can apply an "ephemeral headroom" workaround (temporary quota overlay) if Sales accepts billing exposure (overage risk). 3) Burst window 30m is okay; tighten autoscaler cooldown to avoid oscillation. 4) Hosted fallback route should be set to a small hosted model for transparent failover. 5) For API keys we can create an ephemeral key scoped to the pool and IPs with TTL.

ops-bot: [automated] Received provisioning change request for ded-poc-acme-03. Created ticket POC-5904. Status: awaiting-approval.

Mike (Eng): Proposed configuration patch for ded-poc-acme-03:
```json
{"min_capacity":"6","burst_window":"30m","cooldown":"15m","fallback_route":"hosted-small","ephemeral_credits":"50"}
```
Notes: - cooldown 15m to reduce thrash - ephemeral_credits 50 will auto-expire after the demo - add alerting: >80% usage for 5m -> page on-call.

Charlie (Infra): Implementation steps:
1) Sales approves billing exposure for ephemeral credits/overage.
2) Schedule ephemeral change at T-2h before demo. Apply pool overlay & attach ephemeral quota.
3) Create ephemeral API key `acme-poc-demo-ephemeral` TTL=72h, restrict by IP allowlist.
4) Add routing fallback to hosted-small with a tail-latency threshold of 300ms.
Estimated ops time: ~60-90 minutes.

Elaine (Sales): Sales approves ephemeral credits for the demo only. Irene, confirm TTL=72h and IP allowlist is acceptable?

Irene (ACME): Confirmed TTL 72h and IP allowlist are fine. Thanks for the quick response.

Mike (Eng): I'll create a short runbook and rollback snippet. Rollback command:
```bash
curl -X PATCH https://api.redwood.ai/dedicated/pools/ded-poc-acme-03 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"min_capacity":20,"burst_window":"2h","cooldown":"30m"}'
```
Include in runbook: alert thresholds, who to page, and the exact ticket link.

Charlie (Infra): Ticket POC-5904 updated with timeline, runbook, and scheduled change window. I'll post status when changes are applied.

ops-bot: [automated] POC-5904 status -> scheduled. Change window: 2026-04-02T14:00Z to 2026-04-02T16:00Z.

Elaine (Sales): Great, I'll tell ACME and confirm demo timing. :thumbsup:

Irene (ACME): Appreciate it — see you tomorrow!
